name: 02-task-journey
title: 一项工作，从交出去到完成会经历什么
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a NEW landscape 16:9 editorial material illustration for the introductory subsection “一项工作，从交出去到完成会经历什么”. The attached image is STYLE/CHARACTER reference ONLY, not content to reproduce. Match its warm off-white studio backdrop, matte ceramic and paper textures, sophisticated soft shadows, chibi HUMANOID robots with oversized rounded heads, charcoal screen faces and two eyes, small bodies with complete arms/hands/legs/feet. Rich coordinated cobalt #3158D8, coral #F18C73, mint #76BFA8, butter yellow #E8C76C, lavender #A89ACB accents.
Purpose: explain the user-facing journey BEFORE introducing internal class names. One persistent task may involve waiting, resuming and changing handler; task completion requires verification.
Composition: spacious two-level narrative. Across top a slim continuous cobalt rail and a single paper task card reading “同一任务：修复登录超时”, representing the unchanged objective across the journey. Below, four main scenes arranged clearly left-to-right with connecting arrows: (1) a stylized human hand handing in a yellow request card, label “提出需求”; (2) a coral-accent chibi robot A investigating with magnifier and a small document, label “A 开始处理”; (3) a mint-accent chibi robot B accepting the same task folder and working with a small code block, label “B 接手”; (4) a lavender clipboard with completed regression-test checks and a small finished artifact, label “验收完成”. The arrow A to B has exact short text “必要时转派”. All other main arrows unlabeled.
Under A, two small distinct optional detours, visually subordinate: a speech-bubble object labeled “等待补充” and a pause/resume token labeled “暂停后恢复”. Each detour leaves A and has an unambiguous curved return arrow pointing back to A, NOT onward to B. These are possible interruptions not mandatory sequential steps. Keep loops short, independent, no tangled crossing. No arrows from these detours directly to completion.
Exact text only: 同一任务：修复登录超时; 提出需求; A 开始处理; B 接手; 验收完成; 必要时转派; 等待补充; 暂停后恢复.
Use large clear Simplified Chinese typography, labels next to relevant subjects, generous spacing and 7% safe margins. Avoid extra writing, internal names Task/AgentWorkItem, technical status codes, dashboard UI, spurious performance numbers, logos, watermarks. This is an illustrative scenario not a literal software state machine. No appearance of parallel A and B execution. Professional friendly explanatory scene, beautiful miniature materials, visual clarity first.
editPrompt: Edit this illustration with ONE narrowly targeted diagram correction. Preserve every character, every Chinese label, layout, colors, title, object, main horizontal flow and top persistent-task rail. At bottom below Agent A there are two short curved blue connectors. Make BOTH of these connectors clearly DOUBLE-HEADED, with an arrowhead at each end: left connector links A 开始处理 and 等待补充 in BOTH directions; right connector links A 开始处理 and 暂停后恢复 in BOTH directions. Thus each optional interruption can be entered and returned from. Do not connect the two bottom objects to each other. Add the missing arrowhead at the Agent A end of the left connector, and add the missing arrowhead at the pause/resume-token end of the right connector. Keep connectors away from text. No other changes.
